RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicRectangleCo.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicRectangleConcentration_gaussian_marginal_density
RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicRectangleCo.expanded_type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {p : ℕ} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (V : Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p),
  Measurable V →
    ∀ {C₀ δ κ σ : ℝ},
      0 ≤ C₀ →
        0 ≤ κ →
          0 < σ →
            δ ≤ σ →
              RectangleCLTArxivV1.IntrinsicRectangleConcentration (MeasureTheory.Measure.map V μ) C₀ δ κ →
                ∀ (f : RectangleCLT.Face p) (a : ℝ),
                  ∫ (ω : Ω),
                      ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 ((RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot f (V ω) - a) / σ) /
                        σ ∂μ ≤
                    16 * Real.exp (1 / 2) * C₀ * κ

RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicRectangleCo.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicRectangleConcentration_pair_normal_reference_mass
RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicRectangleCo.expanded_type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {p : ℕ} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (V : Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p),
  Measurable V →
    ∀ {C₀ δ κ h σ ν : ℝ},

RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicRectangleCo.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicRectangleConcentration_pair_angular_reference_mass
RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicRectangleCo.expanded_type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {p : ℕ} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (V : Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p),

    ∀ {C₀ δ κ h σ ν ℓ : ℝ},

                  RectangleCLTArxivV1.IntrinsicRectangleConcentration (MeasureTheory.Measure.map V μ) C₀ δ κ →

                        ∀ (η : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ) [inst_2 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure η]
